# RB-06 Missed or failing scheduled job

Scope: NabaLens internal. Back to the [index](README.md).

| Field                         | Content                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Trigger                       | M-JB-1, M-JB-2, M-JB-3, M-UP-3                                                                                                                     |
| Operator role                 | OPS                                                                                                                                                |
| First checks                  | Check the cron entry, the route's secret and the last ops_job_runs rows.                                                                           |
| Steps                         | Call the route once with its bearer secret, then confirm a second call changes nothing.                                                            |
| Narrowest switch              | Per job                                                                                                                                            |
| Switches in the catalogue     | SW-08 (Cleanup job schedule), SW-09 (Media archive job schedule), SW-10 (Archive watchdog schedule), SW-11 (Monthly coverage preparation schedule) |
| Data implications             | Jobs are idempotent; a rerun never doubles work or counts.                                                                                         |
| Pending delivery              | Delivery jobs resume from their stored revisions; withdrawals are never skipped.                                                                   |
| Readback that proves recovery | A new ok heartbeat and M-JB-1 back to ok.                                                                                                          |

## Checks without a database

- unit: `tests/unit/ops-heartbeats.test.ts`: Each of the four crons writes one terminal heartbeat per authorised run; a missed run breaches M-JB-1 after two intervals
- unit: `tests/unit/coverage-routes.test.ts`: Monthly preparation refuses a missing or wrong bearer (401) and missing configuration (503)
- unit: `tests/unit/media-archive-routes.test.ts`: The media archive routes refuse a missing or wrong bearer
- unit: `tests/unit/archive-monitor-watchdog.test.ts`: The watchdog keeps its own dead-man state
- unit: `tests/unit/ops-switches.test.ts`: Each job switch (SW-08 to SW-11) exists in vercel.json

## Drill

- Description: For each job: skip its calls and see the heartbeat breach; call it once; call it twice and confirm nothing doubles. The four main crons are drillable now; each later job when it ships.
- Readiness: ready_on_main
- Status: queued
- Environment: an owned isolated stack only, never production or a shared database.
- Evidence: `evidence/b10-02/RB-06/`
